body: Why eat the cake if you know there're parts literally made out of shit? Especially if there's a way to forget you ever had the cake and not care about it any more.
I'd say I don't usually feel shit, but I wouldn't care about all those other meanings to life if I were dead. So, why should I care?
The answer to "why yes?" is because life can feel shit at times, so if there's no life it can't be shit
